==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 8''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌8) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 8''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].<ref>[https://namu.wiki/w/%EC%95%84%ED%94%84%EB%A6%AC%EC%B9%B4TV%20%EC%8A%A4%ED%83%80%EB%A6%AC%EA%B7%B8%20%EC%8B%9C%EC%A6%8C8 Afreeca Starleague Season 8]</ref><br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jf1RNhh1shs</embedvideo>

===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV Starleague Season 7]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format:
*** Game 1 and 2: {{abbr/Bo1}}
*** Loser's, winner's and final match: {{abbr/Bo3}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals and semifinals: {{abbr/Bo5}}
** Finals: {{abbr/Bo7}}
